sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] President Recep Tayyip Erdogan told President Donald Trump that Turkiye and its Mecca Joint Defence Alliance partners were closely monitoring developments in the Strait of Hormuz and Yemen and working to resolve them through diplomacy, and that Turkiye stands ready to support efforts to revive the diplomatic process between Ukraine and Russia, per the Turkish presidency readout. Trump congratulated Erdogan on Republic Day (Oct 29) and wished the Organization of Turkic States summit success. NO new US commitment, deployment decision or Hormuz agreement appears in the readout (Bosphorus News notes this explicitly).
